coverage.title: Ink coverage
coverage.empty: Add artwork to estimate ink coverage.
coverage.unavailable: Could not read artwork for the estimate: {{panels}}.
coverage.estimateNote: Estimated from the artwork pixels as placed, clipped to the walls (no bleed; the bottom allowance only for panels extended to the bottom), as % of the dieline sheet area. An approximation for quoting, not a production separation.

hints.NO_PANTONE_COLORS: Add Pantone colours in the "Print & production" step to see coverage per colour.
hints.POOR_COLOR_MATCH: Some artwork colours are far from every Pantone preview colour — check the colour list and previews in the "Print & production" step.

palette.title: Colours in the artwork (HEX)
palette.note: Colours detected in the artwork pixels as placed (same rules as the ink coverage), merged in CIELAB by CIEDE2000: shades closer than ΔE00 {{tolerance}} are one colour, anti-aliased edge pixels (a blend of two colours) belong to the nearer one, colours under {{minShare}} of the ink join the nearest similar colour or "other"; at most {{max}} colours. The HEX is an actual pixel colour of the group. Nearest Pantone and ΔE refer to the preview colours of the print list.

analysis.hint: Merges shades that print as one colour: anti-aliased edges, JPEG compression, gradients. Colours smaller than the minimum spot join the nearest similar colour (or "other").
analysis.summaryValue: similar colours merged at ΔE00 {{tolerance}}, minimum spot {{minShare}} of ink
